_comment: Draft MCP tool definition for check_listing. This is for KG Agent Exchange integration planning only - do not add to any MCP server without review.

tool.name: check_listing
tool.description: Check whether an x402 paid endpoint is discoverable and properly configured, using the 9-signal scoring criteria from the 2026-10-26 survey of 2,735 hosts. Returns a score (0-7 checkable signals), confirmed observations, unverified signals, and concrete fix suggestions in Japanese and English.

url.description: The HTTPS URL of the x402 paid endpoint to check. The checker will fetch this URL without payment and inspect the 402 response, plus check host-level discovery files (/llms.txt, /.well-known/agent-card.json, etc.).

host.description: The hostname extracted from the URL

score.description: Number of checkable signals that were detected (out of 7)

maxScore.description: Maximum possible score for checkable signals (7)

percentile.description: Approximate percentile based on the 2026-10-26 survey score distribution

confirmed.description: Signals that were checked and their detection status

couldNotConfirm.description: Signals that require external data and were not verified (mcp_registry, x402scan_listed)

fixes.description: Suggested fixes for missing signals, in Japanese and English

rawSignals.description: Raw signal results with detection status and details

checkedAt.description: ISO timestamp of when the check was performed

note.description: Caveats and limitations of this check in Japanese and English

examples.description: Check a KGNINJA endpoint that scored 9/9 in the survey
Check a high-revenue endpoint from the survey
